name: Variational Autoencoder (VAE)
summary: Learn a probabilistic latent-variable generative model using an evidence lower bound.
summary_zh: 通过变分下界与重参数化估计潜变量生成模型。
core_idea: Jointly learn a decoder and amortized approximate posterior using reparameterized ELBO optimization.
innovation: Provides a compact learned generative prior that can be used as one ingredient of inverse reconstruction.
limitations: Posterior collapse and variational approximation bias may arise.
Training on population data does not automatically encode individual physics.

start_here.why: Foundational VAE paper explaining reparameterization and amortized inference.
start_here.focus: Latent-variable likelihood, ELBO, encoder/decoder and reparameterization.

curation_note: Bibliographic identity verified against authoritative proceedings; downstream physical inverse validity must be separately evaluated.
